summary:
Implementation plan for the 2026 Kyushu Autumn Maple Journey Mobile Web App.
Covers mobile-first React SPA architecture with local storage persistence and single-file HTML export, hand-drawn Kyushu interactive map with pinch-to-zoom and pin popups, dynamic itinerary with real-time weather and foliage tracking, categorized navigation directory with backup restaurant list, interactive checklists and memo with auto-linking, daily outfit/packing assistant, and comprehensive travel info (flights, hotels, emergency, and 11/1 new tax-free rules).
